Row Over 'Vande Mataram' Verses at Rahul Gandhi Event

A dispute arose at a Rahul Gandhi event concerning the singing of the national song 'Vande Mataram'. Congress stated that only two verses of the song would be sung. A Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader reportedly demanded the full song be sung, but then admitted to knowing only two verses himself. The incident led to increased political friction over the national song.
